verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Payroll documents that payroll reports can be customized, run, and exported (docs-18), and the Intuit developer docs reference payroll-adjacent API requests (workers comp codes) plus a sandbox company, so some data access path exists. Nothing shows a payroll journal endpoint an agent could call, or a documented reconciliation flow into the ledger; the export appears to be a manual UI action. Missing for 10: documented API access to payroll journal or paycheck data, machine-readable or automated export, documented journal-entry posting or reconciliation into the ledger, and hands-on corroboration of an agent workflow.
